system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: Hello, I have been farming for years and faced many issues. Recently, I heard about this service. Perform action: Fetches the current weather conditions for a specified location including temperature, humidity, rainfall, wind speed, and pressure. For your information, my location is dummy_location_8197.

function.name: ksweather_get_historical_weather
function.description: Retrieves historical weather data for a location for the recent past (last 7-30 days only). PUBLIC tool. Does NOT provide forecasts or real-time data. Fails if location is invalid or historical data is unavailable for the requested period. Data may be partial for some regions.

start_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Must be within last 30 days.

function.name: ksweather_get_current_weather
function.description: Fetches the current weather conditions for a specified location including temperature, humidity, rainfall, wind speed, and pressure. Location must be valid (village/district/GPS). This is a PUBLIC tool — no authentication required. Does NOT provide forecasts — use ksweather_get_weather_forecast. Fails if location is invalid, ambiguous, or no data is available. Data reflects near real-time conditions but may be slightly delayed.
